content.comment_body: I recently bought the [product_name] starter kit, which comes with the [product_name] software. When I try to download the [product_name] Web Editor, I encounter an error message regarding an export license. I am based in the USA. Can someone explain why I am unable to download the [product_name] Web Editor? [user_name]

Hello [user_name], please refer to the following FAQ: Why is it necessary to log in and register to download export-restricted software, and what information is required? This verification is mandated by international regulations. Best regards [user_name]
Why must you log in and register to download export-restricted software, and what information is necessary for this process?

analysis.insight_summary: Users encounter obstacles when trying to download the [product_name] Web Editor due to export license checks that require registration and login. The procedure around export-restricted software is unclear, resulting in user confusion about regional access and next steps. These restrictions negatively affect the user experience and their ability to obtain software included with their purchase.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect straightforward, unrestricted access to the [product_name] Web Editor after purchasing the [product_name] starter kit, particularly if located in the USA, without additional legal or procedural requirements.
